_meta.source: Per-country food-security news and bulletin sources, researched and URL-verified 2026-08-31
_meta.notes: One or more reporting sources per country: national statistics offices, agriculture ministries, early-warning units and credible national media, preferring machine-readable feeds. ALL 208 of the 214 scored countries are covered; 200 have at least one RSS/API feed; 749 sources total. Every URL was fetched — http_status and latest_item_seen are OBSERVED values, not inferred. Countries absent from this file are the 33 scored rows with no research pass (mostly small territories).

sources.name: ReliefWeb country updates (MDG)
sources.notes: Country-granular RSS, 20 most recent items, full-text <description>. IMPORTANT: the ReliefWeb JSON API is NOT a drop-in alternative - v1 is decommissioned (HTTP 410) and v2 rejects unregistered clients (HTTP 403, 'not using an approved appname'). This RSS endpoint needs no key. Feed mixes food-security reports with general humanitarian items, so filter titles//themes on the integrator side. Corrected 2026-08-31: the legacy path reliefweb.int/country/<iso3>/rss.xml 301-redirects here (verified), so a client that does not follow redirects sees zero items. ReliefWeb also rate-limits past ~20 rapid requests with a 429 — pace ~1 request per 2s.

sources.name: NBS Nigeria - e-Library release calendar (embedded JSON)

Directly relevant recurring series: 'Selected Food Prices <Month>' and 'Cost of Healthy Diet Report <Month>', both monthly. Observed: 'Selected Food Price July 2026' dated 2026-08-29 and 'Cost of Healthy Diet Report July 2026' dated 2026-08-31. CRITICAL GOTCHA: the array is a release CALENDAR and contains FUTURE scheduled entries (records dated through 2026-12-31 were present on 2026-08-31) - you MUST filter `start <= today` or you will publish unreleased items as news. No RSS exists (/feed and /rss are 404).
